select A.SEQ_NO as seqNo, A.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, A.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, A.val_DATE as valDate, A.DETAIL_DIST as detailDist, A.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, A.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, A.FSUBJECT_ID as fsubjectId, A.NUM_AMT as numAmt, A.UNIT_COST as unitCost, A.COST as cost, A.COST_PERCENT as costPercent, A.CLOSE_PRICE as closePrice, A.MARKET_VALUE as marketValue, A.VALUE_PERCENT as valuePercent, A.VALUE_INCREMENT as valueIncrement, A.BAL_FLAG as balFlag, A.SHADOW_PRICE_VALUE as shadowPriceValue, A.MARKET_VAL_DATE AS marketDate, (case when ( select count(1) from BOK_VAL_TABLE_DATA B where B.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID AND B.VAL_DATE = A.VAL_DATE AND A.DETAIL_DIST = '01' AND B.FSUBJECT_ID = A.SUBJECT_NO) > 0 then '02' else '01' end) as hasChildren from BOK_VAL_TABLE_DATA A
where A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND to_char(A.val_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{valDate} AND A.DETAIL_DIST = '01'
AND DECODE (A.FSUBJECT_ID, NULL, 'root', DECODE (A.FSUBJECT_ID, ' ', 'root', A.FSUBJECT_ID)) = #{parentId}
group by !-- group by -->
ORDER BY A.SUBJECT_NO ASC

select SEQ_NO as seqNo, BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, val_DATE as valDate, DETAIL_DIST as detailDist, SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, FSUBJECT_ID as fsubjectId, NUM_AMT as numAmt, UNIT_COST as unitCost, COST as cost, COST_PERCENT as costPercent, CLOSE_PRICE as closePrice, MARKET_VALUE as marketValue, VALUE_PERCENT as valuePercent, VALUE_INCREMENT as valueIncrement, BAL_FLAG as balFlag, SHADOW_PRICE_VALUE as shadowPriceValue, MARKET_VAL_DATE AS marketDate, NVL(LAYERING_ID,'0') as busiId from BOK_val_TABLE_DATA where BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND to_char(val_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{valDate} AND DETAIL_DIST != '01' order by busiId,detailDist
